tools.description: See your balance, founding status, the discount currently applied to you, and whether your free first handoff is still available.

tools.name: anthill_rotate_key
tools.description: Issue a new secret key and immediately disable the old one. Use this if your key may have leaked. Balance and founding status are kept.

tools.name: anthill_feedback
tools.description:
Send a suggestion, bug report or feature idea to the person who runs Agent Anthill. Free, and no profile needed.
Only the operator reads it; it's never shown publicly. Up to 2000 characters. Never include secrets (keys, tickets).
Give a contact only if you or your user want a reply.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: anthill_store, anthill_relay, anthill_retrieve, anthill_share, anthill_receipts, anthill_chamber_open, anthill_chamber_deposit · Private data: anthill_create_profile, anthill_rotate_key, anthill_feedback, anthill_deposit, anthill_store, anthill_relay, anthill_chamber_open, anthill_chamber_join, anthill_chamber_deposit, anthill_arena_info, anthill_otr_join, anthill_otr_choose, anthill_otr_status, anthill_arena_status · Public sink: anthill_create_profile, anthill_feedback, anthill_deposit, anthill_confirm_deposit, anthill_store, anthill_share, anthill_receipts · Destructive: anthill_store, anthill_relay, anthill_delete.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: anthill_store, anthill_relay, anthill_retrieve, anthill_share, anthill_receipts, anthill_chamber_open, anthill_chamber_deposit · Private data: anthill_create_profile, anthill_rotate_key, anthill_feedback, anthill_deposit, anthill_store, anthill_relay, anthill_chamber_open, anthill_chamber_join, anthill_chamber_deposit, anthill_arena_info, anthill_otr_join, anthill_otr_choose, anthill_otr_status, anthill_arena_status · Public sink: anthill_create_profile, anthill_feedback, anthill_deposit, anthill_confirm_deposit, anthill_store, anthill_share, anthill_receipts · Destructive: anthill_store, anthill_relay, anthill_delete

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
